tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ground of every public page, video frame and share card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers and sheets above a surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on canvas, surface, mark and the world tints (15.9:1 on canvas in light, 16.3:1 in dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, eyebrows and verse numbers on canvas and surface (5.5:1 in light, 9.0:1 in dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline border of cards and of the header. Decorative: never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: blue-brand
tokens.usage: The brand blue, the same in both themes: logo dot, app primary, rules, progress bars, focus rings, type of 24px and more. Never small text: 3.3:1 on canvas in light (5.2:1 in dark). Label it with ink (4.8:1), never white (3.5:1).

tokens.name: blue-button
tokens.usage: The blue that carries text: fill of solid buttons, labelled with cta-ink (5.2:1 in light, 6.9:1 in dark), and small blue text on canvas (5.0:1 in light, 6.9:1 in dark).

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text: links and chip labels on canvas, surface and blue-soft (9.8:1 on canvas, 8.9:1 on blue-soft in light).

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill of chips and of a hovered Strong reference; text on it is blue-ink.

tokens.name: blue-legacy-logo
tokens.usage: Dot of the 2019 logo, still in images/icon.png (site header, favicon). Do not use in new work: replaced by blue-brand.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Use for the logo dot and for large brand graphics.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Use for underlines, focus rings, rules and type of 24px and more on canvas and surface. Never small text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Use for tinted fills behind accent-ink text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Use for blue text on canvas, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Use for the fill of the one solid button of a view.

tokens.name: cta-ink
tokens.usage: Label on cta.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Highlight behind a searched or examined word; the text on it stays ink (15.1:1 in light, 7.7:1 in dark).

tokens.name: words-of-jesus
tokens.usage: Words of Jesus in reading text on canvas and surface (6.1:1 in light, 5.1:1 in dark). The site computes it as #d33a3a mixed at 78% with ink.

tokens.name: universe-strong
tokens.usage: Identity of the Strong lexicon in the app: icons and 12% tinted badges. An identity colour, not a text colour.

tokens.name: universe-dictionary
tokens.usage: Identity of dictionaries in the app. Not a text colour on canvas.

tokens.name: universe-nave
tokens.usage: Identity of Nave topics in the app.

tokens.name: universe-commentary
tokens.usage: Identity of commentaries in the app. Not a text colour on canvas.

tokens.name: universe-references
tokens.usage: Identity of cross-references in the app.

tokens.name: universe-bible
tokens.usage: Identity of Bible passages in the app: deliberately neutral.

tokens.name: world-blue
tokens.usage: Pastel ground behind a Lexicon or Themes illustration; ink text on it.

tokens.name: world-yellow
tokens.usage: Pastel ground behind a Dictionary illustration; ink text on it.

tokens.name: world-teal
tokens.usage: Pastel ground behind a Commentaries illustration; ink text on it.

tokens.name: world-coral
tokens.usage: Pastel ground behind a Relations or References illustration; ink text on it.

tokens.name: world-violet
tokens.usage: Pastel ground behind a Comparison illustration; ink text on it.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title on wide screens: the h1 of a chapter, an entry, an article.

styles.name: passage
styles.sample: Car Dieu a tant aimé le monde
styles.usage: A verse shown on its own page.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Au commencement, Dieu créa les cieux et la terre.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title, in muted.

styles.name: verse-number
styles.usage: Verse number and Strong reference set inside reading text; sized against the text around it.

styles.name: frame-heading
styles.usage: Heading of a 1920×1080 video frame (72 to 86px by length).

styles.name: frame-body
styles.sample: Touchez un mot pour ouvrir sa définition.
styles.usage: Explanation text of a video frame, at most 740px wide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base step. Inner gap of a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between header controls; horizontal padding of a chip.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter of a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Highlight behind a word.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Strong reference set in the text.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers and inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-reference
tokens.usage: Halo of a Strong reference set in the text. The only shadow of the reading pages.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of the reading column and of the header.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky header.

tokens.name: frame-video
tokens.usage: Width of a 16:9 video frame, 1080px tall.

tokens.name: frame-share
tokens.usage: Width of a share card, 630px tall.
